name: Micro USB socket (GCT USB3076)
summary: Micro-B socket for the edge of a board, as on older dev boards. Needs a 7.8 x 2.8 mm slot.
source: GCT USB3076-30-A drawing, revision C6: body 7.40 mm wide, 5.55 mm deep and 2.35 mm tall, mouth 6.90 x 1.85 mm, front at the board edge. The 7.8 x 2.8 mm slot clears the 6.85 x 1.8 mm plug shell. The plug moulding is far bigger than the shell, so the socket has to sit right behind the wall.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and its cable

electrical.note: Power pins rated 1.8 A, signal pins 1 A, at 30 V AC.
